It's possible, but understandable. You care about her and want the best for her. Nothing wrong with that.

But let's put things in perspective. I have a prison in my area which I go past several times a month. There are always people there to visit people incarcerated there. And there are always young people among them...many with children in strollers! If visiting was as traumatic and dangerous as you fear, that wouldn't be the case.

And this isn't some kind of "country club" type prison, either. We're talking barbed wire, towers with shotgun wielding guards on top, etc.

If it makes you feel any better, visiting time is one of the calmest, safest times there is in a prison. Everyone knows that they have to be on their best behavior during visits. Anyone who steps out of line risks spoiling it for everyone...and that's dealt with severely in there. Visiting time is an opportunity to connect with the outside world, and that's extremely precious.
